picks.title: Foundry's SmartRoto: AI-assisted roto that aims to work the way you do
picks.excerpt: Foundry released SmartRoto, an AI-powered plugin for Nuke, NukeX, Nuke Studio and Nuke Indie built on a proprietary machine-learning model trained over four years. Artists key significant frames and SmartRoto snaps roto splines into place across a shot — up to 4x faster than manual rotoscoping while keeping spline-based precision and artist control.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability — a shipping Nuke plugin that makes rotoscoping up to 4x faster while preserving spline precision changes a compositor's daily workflow immediately; credible fxguide deep-dive on a brand-new release.

picks.title: Lightcraft Technology Opens Spark Story Beta at SIGGRAPH 2026
picks.excerpt: Lightcraft opened a rolling beta of Spark Story, a browser-based interactive previs system that loads Final Draft scripts, parses them for locations and characters, and ties every shot to a scene. It ships with 25+ World Labs 'Marble' environments and 300+ 3D assets, plus Gaussian splats, USD import and real-time 24p iOS live-action compositing so global teams can workshop a virtual film set from day one.
picks.rationale: Novel, hands-on tool now open to sign-ups — script-to-previs in the browser with Gaussian splats and live-action compositing lets directors and previs artists workshop a virtual set today; distinct outlet (AWN) keeps the trio diverse.

picks.title: Foundry Adds Griptape Enterprise for Pro-Grade AI in VFX
picks.excerpt: Foundry announced Griptape Enterprise, an AI workflow-orchestration tier with studio-controlled licensing and on-prem deployment that lets pipeline supervisors curate exactly which AI models artists use, keeping VFX workflows vetted and production-ready.
picks.rationale: Directly actionable for pipeline supervisors — studio-controlled, on-prem AI orchestration that dictates exactly which models VFX artists can run day to day; credible postPerspective report on a fresh enterprise tier.
